title: Glass-core packaging substrates in volume production

research.what: Intel showed glass-core substrates as a replacement for the organic material in advanced chip packages, with tuneable thermal expansion and better flatness for large AI packages. Origin: Intel glass core substrate research announcement, September 2023

change.what: Substrate makers including Absolics (SKC) and Samsung Electro-Mechanics have published targets to begin volume production of glass-core substrates in 2027, after BOE qualified a pilot line and sent samples to customers in September 2026.

note: Glass cores could get past the warpage and size limits of organic substrates that now hold back very large AI accelerator packages, but mass-production dates have slipped several times.

refs.label: Tech Times: BOE completes glass core substrate qualification (Sep 2026)
IRZ: Glass chip substrates still have no commercial product (Sep 2026)

security.note: This is a packaging-material change, so it adds no new remote attack surface, though concentrating supply among a few makers creates supply-chain risk.

title: Kubota M5 Narrow tractor autonomy package (with Agtonomy)

research.what: Agtonomy developed retrofit autonomy software that lets existing compact tractors for specialty crops run without a driver, and later worked with Kubota on it. Origin: Agtonomy's autonomy platform for compact tractors in vineyards and orchards (company founded about 2021; the year is not confirmed by the cited sources)

change.what: At CES in January 2026, Kubota began selling an autonomy package for its 105.7 hp M5 Narrow tractor. Treasury Wine Estates was already running four of these tractors in North Napa Valley for mowing and under-vine cultivation.

note: It is the first time a major tractor maker has sold factory autonomy for narrow-row specialty crops such as vineyards and orchards, adding to Deere's driverless tillage on row-crop farms.

refs.label: Global Brands Magazine – Autonomous Tractors: 16 Cameras and No Driver in 2026

security.note: Connected, software-defined tractors that are supervised remotely give attackers new targets: the fleet-management link and the autonomy software could be tampered with to disrupt farm work or cause unsafe machine movement.

title: Mobile Telephone Service (first car phone network)

research.what: Bell Labs engineers worked on a VHF radio system that let people in cars make and receive calls through the public switched telephone network. Origin: Bell Telephone Laboratories mobile radiotelephone development programme in the early-to-mid 1940s, using Western Electric and Motorola equipment

change.what: On 17 June 1946 Southwestern Bell opened the Bell System's Mobile Telephone Service in St. Louis, and the first mobile phone call to the public network was made there; by 1948 the service reached about 100 towns and highway corridors.

note: This was the first commercial mobile phone service connected to the public telephone network, and it led directly to later IMTS and cellular systems.

refs.label: IEEE-USA InSight – Foundations of Mobile and Cellular Telephony

security.note: Calls were sent unencrypted on shared party-line channels, so anyone with a receiver could listen in.
